queries_run: Oscar Health 10-K customer concentration risk CMS premium subsidies revenue percent

findings.claim: FY2022 10-K：2022 年約 85%、2021 年約 73% 的會員保費由 APTC 補貼（對聯邦補貼依賴度，非單一客戶占比；無單一客戶營收占比數字）
findings.excerpt: During the years ended December 31, 2022 and 2021, the direct policy premiums of approximately 85% and 73%, respectively, of our members were subsidized by APTCs.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 將 eAPTC 到期與 CMS program integrity rules 列為影響估計的法規變動
findings.excerpt: changes in legislation and regulations (including the expiration of the eAPTCs and the CMS program integrity rules)

customer_concentration_credit.note: 未找到單一客戶占營收比重或對手信用惡化的來源；客戶為個人會員，主要集中於聯邦補貼與州別（FY2024 10-K 提及 FL/TX/GA），僅 1 次搜尋。
